summary: Explains ansible.netcommon.vlan_parser (2.8+), which turns an unsorted VLAN list into IOS-style sorted ranges with line length limits, and a template that generates switchport trunk allowed vlan lines.
questions: How do I convert a list of VLAN IDs into an IOS-style range string?
How do I generate switchport trunk allowed vlan commands from a list?

answer_card.title: Formatting VLAN lists with vlan_parser
